mapper.sql: id, passenger_info_id, capital, give_fee, freeze_capital, freeze_give_fee, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_passenger_wallet (passenger_info_id, capital, give_fee, freeze_capital, freeze_give_fee, create_time, update_time) values (#{passengerInfoId}, #{capital}, #{giveFee}, #{freezeCapital}, #{freezeGiveFee}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update tbl_passenger_wallet set capital = capital + #{amount}, update_time = now() where passenger_info_id = #{passengerInfoId}
